notes:
- New: works with the standalone MTG Arena (Wizards installer) as well as Steam. The launcher finds it on its own; if MTG Arena has not finished downloading its game files yet, it tells you to start MTG Arena once and sign in until the main menu.
- Fix: preparing the game failed after MTG Arena downloaded content for its next release ("expected one main manifest"). The patch now uses the content your game build plays with.
- New: in every deck picker, decks saved in the format you are queuing for come first.
- New: illegal blocks (menace and other block restrictions) are flagged, and Submit stays disabled until the blocks are legal.
- New: player counters, the city's blessing and planeswalker emblems now show in the game.
- Fix: tooltips no longer show in all caps.
- The download no longer includes MTGA-Forge.cmd: start MTGA-Forge.exe.
